name: Himalayas
description: Two continental plates collide. Neither readily sinks, so the crust shortens, thickens, and rises into mountains.

name: Andes
description: Dense oceanic crust of the Nazca Plate descends beneath South America, feeding volcanoes and powerful earthquakes.

name: San Andreas Fault
description: The Pacific and North American plates slide horizontally past one another, storing and releasing stress as earthquakes.

name: Mid-Atlantic Ridge
description: New oceanic crust forms as plates pull apart, gradually widening the Atlantic Ocean.

name: East African Rift
description: The African Plate is stretching and thinning. Over geological time, this continental rift may open into a new ocean basin.
